intro: The ground trembles beneath your feet.$Ahead, a collapsed den crackles with crimson energy — and something enormous is stirring inside…
title: The Collapsed Den
description: A {{titanName}} swollen to impossible size by leaking Dynamax energy rampages within the ruined den. Driving it off won't be easy — but that energy has to condense somewhere…

1.label: Enter the Den
1.tooltip:
(-) Fight a Titan Boss
(+) Dynamax Band and Max Mushrooms
1.selected: The {{titanName}} roars as you descend into the crackling ruin!

2.label: Back Away Slowly
2.selected: You retreat before the titan notices you.$The den's rumbling fades behind you.

outro: With the titan defeated, the loose Dynamax energy condenses into something you can carry…
